title: Semaglutide and Tirzepatide Effects on Cardiovascular Outcomes in People with Overweight or Obesity in the Real World (STEER)

key_findings.claim: Continuous GLP-1 care demonstrated a 57% lower rate of major adverse cardiovascular events (heart attack, stroke, CV death) compared to inconsistent treatment
key_findings.citation_location: Wilson et al., Diabetes Obes Metab 2026;28(3):2403-2415, Per-Protocol Analysis
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Cardiovascular and metabolic protection requires continuous, doctor-guided care rather than sporadic off-label usage.

key_findings.claim: Overall real-world risk reduction of 29% for serious cardiovascular complications even with occasional treatment interruptions
key_findings.clinical_interpretation: Metabolic health is directly tied to vascular protection; clinical weight management extends life expectancy.
